item.title: Harbour city floods after river bursts banks
item.description: The river burst its banks on Sunday and flooded the harbour city of Testport. Officials said 1,200 people left their homes. Emergency crews opened three shelters.

item.title: Parliament of Examplia approves water treaty
item.description: Lawmakers in Examplia approved a water-sharing treaty with neighbouring Samplestan by 140 votes to 60. The treaty covers the Blue River basin.
